 East Bengal vs Al Seeb – What happened last time they met?
 East Bengal was held to a 0-0 draw by Oman club Al Seeb when the two sides met in the reverse fixture late last month.
 Here is how the action unfolded​ AFC Champions League 2: East Bengal shares spoils in dull draw with Al Seeb
 The result earned Al Seeb its first point in this season’s continental tournament, but East Bengal’s winless streak continued with a consecutive draw.

 November 03, 2026 17:54 
 East Bengal vs Al Seeb – Match preview!
 East Bengal FC faces a crucial test against Oman’s Al-Seeb Club at the Salt Lake Stadium on Tuesday as both sides seek their first victory in the AFC Champions League Two group stage.
 The stakes are high for Antonio Lopez Habas’ men as East Bengal sits third in Group D with two points (gained from the two draws away from home) from three matches. Al-Seeb is at the bottom with one point.
 With only the top two teams advancing to the Round of 16, both sides desperately need a win to revive their qualification hopes. 
 Read full preview ​ East Bengal eyes first win in AFC Champions League Two against bottom-placed Al-Seeb
 East Bengal hosts Al-Seeb in a must-win AFC Champions League Two clash at Salt Lake Stadium amid hopes to spark a first victory and advance.
